<reason>PRO better defined prioritization as redirecting marginal investment while existing exports continue, answered the hard-currency attack with net import-bill savings and higher-value sales, and exposed CON's industrialize-later sequence as having no credible endpoint. CON's warning that extraction needs continuing investment landed, but did not defeat PRO's phased, essentials-first regional manufacturing case.</reason>
